messages:
taylor: quick thread on PR #5088 — disconnected/install.md currently uses literal IPs in the KMS/HSM examples which made QA think IPs are required. want to land a clearer recommendation.
rui: agreed. canonical guidance should be: prefer resolvable hostnames and TLS certs. IPs in /etc/hosts are only for bootstrap.
andre: +1. also add a single-line rule that cert CN or SAN must include the hostname clients use (or the IP if you insist on IP-based certs). we've hit breakage when customers used IP-only CNs.
zara: comments to include: 1) show hostname-first example, 2) then show a minimal /etc/hosts fallback, 3) give a secure curl example that validates TLS rather than showing --insecure.
taylor: here's a proposed snippet to add under "DNS and host resolution":
```
# preferred: hostname with certs
# /etc/hosts not required if DNS is configured
# example TLS endpoint: kms.example.internal
# client will validate TLS CN/SAN against the hostname

# fallback (bootstrap only):
# /etc/hosts
10.200.0.5 kms.example.internal
10.200.0.6 hsm-01.example.internal
```
rui: add a curl example that demonstrates validating the cert when using /etc/hosts: 
```
curl --resolve "kms.example.internal:443:10.200.0.5" \
  --cacert /etc/redwood/kms/ca.pem \
  https://kms.example.internal/health
```
andre: HSM appendix: include a vendor-agnostic PKCS#11 stub and a short note to check vendor tooling for slot/token discovery. snippet:
```
pkcs11:
  library: /usr/lib/libpkcs11-vendor.so  # vendor-supplied path
  token: "hsm-token-01"
  slot: 0  # verify with vendor tool
  pin_env: HSM_PIN  # prefer env var over inline secret
```
andre: also call out that some HSMs expose management interfaces on a separate network interface; remind users to allow mgmt traffic in firewall rules.
zara: troubleshooting addendum: hairpin/NAT note. common symptom: control-plane probes to internal IPs succeed from external tests but pods cannot reach the same IP due to SNAT. recommend enabling NAT loopback or hairpin on the gateway, or use hostnames so the gateway can resolve correctly.
taylor: docs maintenance: i fixed two stale anchors that referenced the old certs section id. pushed a tiny commit to the PR.
docs-bot: docs-ci: build started for PR #5088 (:hourglass:)
infra-bot: infra-check: internal linkcheck found two links to /install#networking-old-anchor — replaced by taylor in branch.
docs-bot: docs-ci: build succeeded for PR #5088 (:white_check_mark:)
rui: LGTM after adding the hairpin bullet under Troubleshooting. thanks all.
taylor: will squash and merge. proposed changelog blurb: "Disconnected install: clarified KMS/HSM addressing and cert CN/SAN guidance; added PKCS#11 example and hairpin NAT troubleshooting."
andre: thanks — small but useful clarification for customers in semi-airgapped environments.
